meta.description: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, efficiency, and capital. Use when preparing a business review or prioritizing urgent fixes.

copy.tagline: 诊断SaaS业务健康度，聚焦增长、留存与效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责SaaS产品运营，需要快速定位业务短板
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, and efficiency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a SaaS product and need to quickly identify weak spots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你提供增长、留存、单位经济和资本效率四类指标，然后生成一份 SaaS 业务健康诊断报告，包含健康评分、危险信号和优先行动建议。
howto.when: 当你准备董事会汇报、季度回顾或融资材料，需要全面评估 SaaS 业务健康状况时触发。

say.text: 准备董事会材料，检查一下我们的增长和留存指标。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供相关指标并生成报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to provide metrics across growth, retention, unit economics, and capital efficiency, then generate a comprehensive SaaS business health diagnostic with scores, red flags, and prioritized recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a holistic health assessment for board meetings, quarterly reviews, or fundraising preparation.

say_en.text: Run a health check: $8M ARR, 60% YoY growth, NRR 96%.
say_en.note: Claude will start the diagnostic based on these metrics.

say_en.text: Prepare board materials and check our growth and retention metrics.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the process.
